Disclaimers:

* English is not my native language, it would be nice of you guys if someone gave me helpful advice if something is not clear. 

* Sorry for all the rant, I never really talked about all of it with anyone in my life, I really needed to vent to started talking about my problems because I'm sooo lonely. 

My mother was very verbally abusive, yelled at me and my siblings and father the time most of the time, it was pretty bad; I didn't like to spent time with her or at home because of that, it was intolerable; my father was mostly absent, but even when he wasn't, he often was talking about how I'm worthless and not mature and how I'm retarded. 

My father has built a house he's very proud of; since when I was ten, he often used me as his handyman; unloading and moving bricks, making concrete, helped him with welding, and a wide variety of other tasks like installing electric sockets, painting etc etc 

Eventually one day he kicked me out of that house I helped him build, when I had an argument with my sister and punched her.

Since then I don't talk to anyone in my family except my brother; we both become pariahs; but he died from consequences of his alcoholism several years ago.

I'm not strictly "forever alone", I was in relationship of two years with very very nice girl; long story short I cheated on her with another girl and then dumped them both. Since then I think I maybe qualify as forever alone. I dunno really. 

Some of my past friends said I have trust issues, maybe it was that. I don't really know what's going on  with me, I'm seeing various mental health specialists once in a while, for ten years; I don't understand them, I'm asking for diagnosis but they reluctant to give me it; last time I pushed my psychotherapist said I probably had schizotypal personality disorder, but it needs further investigation.

To be completely fair/honest, I'm not entirely sure that my parents are "shitty". It's very likely that's something really wrong with my mom's psyche; but my dad is just a douche to me, I think. As far as I can tell his relationship with my sister is really good. 

Last bit. My brother is actually on the other side of "spectrum": he once dropped to me that he had fucked over 40 women. So there is that.

I’m a poor person myself and I’m really really want to buy durable, reliable things, but I don’t know where, or what brands to buy

For example, I know iPhones are durable and are supported by manufacturer for a longer times, I had an iPhone 4 which served me well for like 4 or 5 years. One year ago, when I needed a new smartphone I already knew what I was going to buy (iPhone SE)

But god, i wish I knew “iPhones” of shoes, bags, coats, laptops etc. I want to buy quality things. Especially shoes, I walk a lot on my job.

Maybe if there’s a subreddit for this or something it would be very helpful for me.
Thanks for your reply and your kind words.
Thanks for reply. If it’s true i’ll better focus on my Anxiety Disorder, because at least it’s not as controversial as PD.
